This looks complete and correct. The screen is built with:

- **Search with keyboard-navigable suggestions**: `Combobox` (React Aria under the hood) filters a suggestion pool as you type; arrow keys move through them, Enter selects, Escape reverts — all built in.
- **Results**: choosing a suggestion filters the 6 mock benefits (name/category/description match) and renders each as a `Card` with name, category `Tag`, one-line description, and an eligibility `Badge` (icon + text, not color-only).
- **No-results state**: some suggestions (e.g. "Childcare", "Pet insurance") intentionally match none of the 6 benefits, showing an `EmptyState`.
- **Idle state**: before any choice, a prompt `EmptyState` invites the person to search.

Everything is mock data defined directly in `Screen.tsx`; only `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css` were created/edited, using layout-logical CSS (`inline-size`, `margin-inline`, etc.) so it holds up in the RTL locale and across brands/dark mode via Strata tokens.
